purpose: Keep the precision of the public output representation separate from the arithmetic precision used to construct the current Kokuno post-relative-swirl release1 field.

user_requirement: A clear computable save/load-capable 3-D time-dependent velocity(x,y,z,t)->[u,v,w] is a delivery requirement.
Callable velocity delivery is independent from visual correspondence, PDE validation, paper exactness and OpenAI-field identity.
public_source_fact: For the first post-relative-swirl release interval the pinned reconstruction prescribes s=log(X/X_rel) in [0,1], ell(s)=-lambda-(1-lambda)*sigma(s), U=0 and D_logX log(E)=ell-1/2.
The pinned reconstruction prescribes the later ell=-1 hold and subsequent -1 to -h transition, but PR #1188 materializes only the first unit release interval.
autonomous_design: PR #1188 evaluates the new release1 profile, fixed 96-point Gauss-Legendre sigma integral and Cartesian assembly with Python/NumPy binary64 arithmetic.
PR #1188 then embeds each already-computed binary64 Cartesian component into Decimal under the inherited fixed 96-significant-digit ROUND_HALF_EVEN context.

The 96-digit Decimal public representation is a representation/serialization choice inherited from PR #1179; it is not evidence that all newly introduced release1 arithmetic was evaluated at 96-digit precision.
pending_unknown: An end-to-end multiprecision recomputation of the newly introduced release1 profile, quadrature and Cartesian assembly has not been materialized on this lineage.
Whether a future multiprecision release1 implementation changes any downstream numerical receipt remains unknown until it is implemented and replayed.

The ell=-1 hold, -1 to -h transition, terminal multiplier, exterior heat replacement, global leading field, matched pressure, restricted forcing, full held-out NS residual, visual correspondence and exact OpenAI-field identity remain separate pending gates.

representation_identity.semantic_rule: Output scalar encoding and internal arithmetic precision are distinct parts of representation provenance and must not be conflated.

forbidden_evidence_transfers: Decimal-valued return objects must not be described as proof of 96-digit end-to-end numerical construction.

PR #1179 evidence that its pre-release sub-epsilon correction survives its precision-qualified representation must not be reused as evidence that the new PR #1188 release1 computations were performed at 96 digits.

A4 PR #1191 use of higher-precision arithmetic in an implementation-distinct divergence audit must not be described as increasing the arithmetic precision of the underlying A1 #1188 candidate evaluator.
A stable Decimal serialization or callable stage must not promote global velocity readiness, visual correspondence, PDE validation, paper exactness or OpenAI-field identity.

promotion_rule.future_true_multiprecision_release1: If profile evolution, quadrature or Cartesian assembly is recomputed in true multiprecision rather than binary64-before-Decimal embedding, treat that as a new numerical representation/candidate identity.
required_replay: finite Cartesian values on the claimed stage domain
all downstream receipts that depend numerically on the changed release1 evaluator
promotion_rule.no_backward_promotion: The current binary64-before-Decimal implementation remains a valid callable stage; lack of 96-digit internal arithmetic is not a reason to block delivery, but it limits precision claims.

mechanics_witness_scope: Any decimal-vs-binary64 collision witness in the regression is autonomous representation mechanics only; it is not Kokuno/OpenAI numerical evidence and is not PDE evidence.
